text:
Mike: Quick experiment dump — investigating continuous-batcher fairness across GPUs. Ran 4h sweep with new kernel-selector + kv-aware packing. TL;DR: H100/A100 tolerate bigger token budgets; T4 shows ~18% p99 spike when max_tokens_per_batch > 9k.

Rachael: can you paste the configs and the perf logs?

Mike: Putting the candidate config and a couple of perf snippets below.
```json
{
  "batching": {
    "age_ms": 12,
    "max_batch_size": {"A10":64,"T4":48,"L4":96,"A100":128,"H100":192},
    "max_tokens_per_batch": {"A10":8192,"T4":9216,"L4":16384,"A100":32768,"H100":65536},
    "soft_token_cap_pct": 0.9,
    "kv_pack_threshold": 0.6
  }
}
```

Mike: Quick profiler output (aggregated):
```
GPU  | avg_seq | kv_frag | p50_ms | p99_ms
-----+---------+---------+--------+--------
T4   |   256   |  0.42   |  48    |  220  <-- spike when tokens/batch > 9k
A10  |   512   |  0.36   |  34    |  120
L4   |   320   |  0.28   |  30    |   90
A100 |   640   |  0.23   |  22    |   60
H100 |   768   |  0.21   |  18    |   45
```

Amit: Where's the kernel selector decision log? are we falling back to slow kernels on T4?

Mike: Yes — for short-ish sequences (<128) kernel-selector sometimes chooses generic matmul path instead of the small-sequence fused kernel. That's most obvious on T4 because of memory bandwidth pressure + higher kv fragmentation.

Claire: For rollout: recommend adding two soft rules — (1) force 'fast_small_seq' kernel when seq_len < 128 and model_arch in {gpt2, llama-like}; (2) lower T4 max_tokens_per_batch to 6k as a safety cap and let autoscaler handle bursts. Also increase kv_pack_threshold to 0.7 for T4 to reduce fragmentation.

Rachael: I measured regression traces — when we increased token cap to 12k on T4 p99 went from 190ms -> 225ms and error-rate for timeouts doubled. Agree with conservative T4 cap.

Mike: Proposal (consensus candidate):
- Per-GPU max_batch_size: A10=64, T4=40, L4=96, A100=128, H100=192
- Per-GPU max_tokens_per_batch: A10=8k, T4=6k, L4=16k, A100=24k, H100=48k
- Kernel rule: force fast_small_seq for seq<128
- KV packing: global threshold 0.6, override T4->0.7

perf-bot: CI run 1765432101-rc1: canary applied to eu-west-1 T4 pool — p99 delta +3% across mixed workload (10k requests) :green_heart:

Amit: we should add an automated check comparing kernel-selection distribution pre/post to catch silent fallbacks.

Mike: action: I'll roll rc1 with the candidate config to 10% of T4 capacity now, monitor p50/p99 + kernel-selection histogram for 2h. If p99 stays <= +5% we'll expand. cc @Claire for infra quota and @Rachael for perf dash update.

Claire: noted, I'll reserve extra burst nodes if we need to offload.

Rachael: :thumbsup:

Mike: thanks — will post a short follow-up after 2h with numbers.
